meta.title: Covelet · Your everyday sites, one new tab
meta.description: A new tab for Chrome and Edge. Organize sites, search the web and keep notes. No Covelet account needed. Data is encrypted in this browser by default, with optional bring-your-own-storage sync (Beta).
hero.h1: Your everyday sites. One new tab.
hero.tagline: Keep sites in order, search the web and jot down a thought.
hero.lead: Covelet replaces the new tab in Chrome and Edge. No Covelet account needed. Your data is encrypted in this browser by default. Connect your own storage when you want to sync across devices.
features.organize_body: Add sites, group them in folders and drag them into place.
features.search_body: Search the web, or find sites and notes stored in this browser.
features.notes_body: Write a note or save a link to read later.
features.appearance_body: Choose a background, icon size and layout that work for you.
privacy.title: Know where your data lives.
privacy.local_body: Sites, notes and settings are encrypted in this browser. You do not need a Covelet account, and no Covelet product server receives this content.
privacy.network_body: The extension collects no usage statistics and uploads no logs automatically. Sync, daily wallpapers, searches and manual site lookups do connect to the internet. Privacy checkup explains permissions and their purposes.
privacy.site_note: This website may use Cloudflare Web Analytics to count page visits, separately from extension data. See the privacy policy for details.
sync.title: Sync with your storage (Beta)
sync.intro: Connect your own storage to use your data across devices. Sync content is encrypted and sent directly to that storage, without passing through a Covelet server.
sync.step1_body: WebDAV is recommended, including services such as Nutstore and Nextcloud. Prepare a save folder and an app password first.
sync.step2_body: Check that the save folder can be read. The test uploads nothing and does not verify writes or your sync password.
sync.step3_body: Choose a new password for a new, empty folder. On other devices, use the same folder and its existing sync password, then start syncing.
sync.note: Saving a connection does not start sync. Automatic sync is off by default. When enabled, it runs only while a Covelet page is open and the connection is unlocked.
sync.conflict_body: Compare versions, then choose one complete set of content. The choice affects other changes in that set too, so review its scope first.
sync.beta_note: R2, OSS, GitHub and GitLab are also available as Beta options. Keep a separate backup. Your sync password cannot be recovered.
backup.title: Keep a separate backup.
backup.intro: Export your data to a file outside the browser. When restoring, preview it first and choose what to restore and how.
backup.export_body: Back up sites, folders, appearance, notes, read-later links and desktop layouts. Exported files are not encrypted and include hidden content. Keep them somewhere safe.
backup.bookmarks_body: Choose a bookmark HTML file exported by your browser, preview it locally, then import. Existing URLs are kept by default. Imported content follows your sync settings.
backup.note: Before a restore, Covelet keeps a copy in this browser. It does not replace a separate backup file. Storage credentials, sync passwords and passwords used to hide content are not automatically included in backups.
close.title: Start with the sites you use.
close.body: Add, remove and organize sites to make the new tab work your way.
